mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(fee), 0) FROM course WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND end_time < NOW() AND start_time >= #{start} AND start_time < #{end}
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, start_time, end_time)), 0) FROM course WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND end_time < NOW() AND start_time >= #{start} AND start_time < #{end}
SELECT IFNULL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM course WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND start_time >= #{start} AND start_time < #{end}

SELECT CASE WHEN c.course_type = '家教' THEN CONCAT('家教-', COALESCE(c.student_name, '未知')) ELSE COALESCE(o.name, '未分类') END AS name, IFNULL(SUM(c.fee), 0) AS value FROM course c LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.id = c.organization_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.end_time < NOW() AND c.start_time >= #{start} AND c.start_time < #{end} GROUP BY CASE WHEN c.course_type = '家教' THEN CONCAT('家教-', COALESCE(c.student_name, '未知')) ELSE COALESCE(o.name, '未分类') END ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT c.student_name AS name, IFNULL(o.name, '') AS organizationName, COUNT(*) AS courseCount, IFNULL(SUM(c.fee), 0) AS fee FROM course c LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.id = c.organization_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.end_time < NOW() AND c.start_time >= #{start} AND c.start_time < #{end} GROUP BY c.student_name, o.name ORDER BY IFNULL(o.name, '') = '', IFNULL(o.name, ''), fee DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN c.course_type = '家教' THEN CONCAT('家教-', COALESCE(c.student_name, '未知')) ELSE COALESCE(o.name, '未分类') END AS name, CASE WHEN MAX(c.course_type) = '家教' THEN 'tutor' ELSE 'org' END AS targetType, CASE WHEN MAX(c.course_type) = '家教' THEN COALESCE(MAX(c.student_name), '未知') ELSE COALESCE(MAX(o.name), '未分类') END AS targetKey, CASE WHEN MAX(c.course_type) = '家教' THEN '' ELSE GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.student_name SEPARATOR '·') END AS studentNames, COUNT(*) AS courseCount, IFNULL(SUM(c.fee), 0) AS fee FROM course c LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.id = c.organization_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.end_time < NOW() AND c.start_time >= #{start} AND c.start_time < #{end} GROUP BY CASE WHEN c.course_type = '家教' THEN CONCAT('家教-', COALESCE(c.student_name, '未知')) ELSE COALESCE(o.name, '未分类') END ORDER BY fee DESC

SELECT o.id AS organizationId, COALESCE(o.name, '未分类') AS organizationName, c.student_name AS studentName, COUNT(*) AS courseCount, IFNULL(SUM(c.fee), 0) AS fee FROM course c LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.id = c.organization_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.end_time < NOW() AND c.start_time >= #{start} AND c.start_time < #{end} AND (c.course_type IS NULL OR c.course_type <> '家教') GROUP BY o.id, c.student_name ORDER BY o.id, fee DESC
